title: Largest economies by GDP
subtitle: 1960 to 2025
hook: Watch how global economic power has shifted across the decades.
setup: This data race tracks the changing Gross Domestic Product of the world's leading nations.

sequence.text: Brazil enters the ranking as a top global economy in 1962.
Spain appears on the leaderboard as one of the largest economies.
The Netherlands joins the top economic rankings in 1977.
Mexico enters the top economies list in 1979.
Russia enters the global economic rankings at seventh place in 1987.
The United States economy reaches 10,250,952,000,000 USD.
India makes a dramatic jump to seventh place among the world's largest economies.
The United States economy scales up to a record 29,298,013,000,000 USD.

ending: Global economic output has expanded significantly over the decades.
